# Evidence — 052 T011: the 051 fleet semantic reconcile (rollup vs debrief §05)

**Artifact**: [`fleet-051-semantics.json`](./fleet-051-semantics.json) — the semantic rollup `telemetry get-fleet pij-4s10mb --roster …` produces over the real 051 run, regenerated by the real `getFleetEvidence` reader (not hand-typed). Pinned by [`fleet-semantics-golden-051.test.ts`](../../../../harness/cli/test/services/telemetry/fleet-semantics-golden-051.test.ts).

## What it proves (AC-07)

The 051 debrief's §05 quality table was **hand-assembled** from repo files. Phase 2 makes it a telemetry output — honestly. The rollup carries only what the **instrumented** lanes captured, and flags the rest `semantics_measured:false` (never zeros). The headline: the run's one CRITICAL finding and its fix cycle are **absent** from the rollup, because the review ran in an untelemetered lane. That absence is the honest answer, not a defect — and it is exactly the gap the debrief's own §05 honesty note called out.

### Method (the honest "over the real 051 fleet")

The orchestrator (claude) lane is the only instrumented lane (per the debrief: the coder emitted 0 artifact events — F-07/DL-004; the reviewer + validator left no harness telemetry — F-05). Its artifact events are **replayed by running the REAL extractors (`artifact-semantics.ts`) over the REAL committed 051 artifacts it authored** — the same capture the live window would have run over those files. The review + validation are deliberately **not** attributed to the orchestrator: they ran in blind lanes, so they stay blind. The three worker lanes resolve their **cost** from their side-channel ledgers (Phase 1) but are `semantics_measured:false`.

## Reconcile vs §05 — every discrepancy

| §05 row | §05 (hand-made) | rollup | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Plan** | CS-3 · Simple · 1 phase | `plan_cs:3 · plan_phases:1` | ✅ **reproduces** |
| **Workshops** | 1 · **5 decisions** | `workshop_decisions:4` | ⚠️ **precision**: the extractor counts `**Selected**` markers (4 present); §05 hand-counted D1–D5 (5). D5 (build order) carries no `Selected` tag. Not a blind lane — an extractor-grammar gap. |
| **Flow rail** | 11 nodes · **9 done** · 23 events | `nodes:11 · nodes_done:11` | ⚠️ **time-of-capture**: §05 was captured mid-run at debrief time (9 done); the committed `the-flow.json` is the FINISHED run (11 done, 26 events). Honest drift, not a mismatch. |
| **Flow rail (chores)** | 5 chores · 4 done · 1 pending | `chores_done:0 · chores_todo:0` | ⚠️ **source model**: the flight-plan extractor counts `type:"chore"` nodes; 051's `the-flow.json` has none (its harness chores aren't modelled as chore-typed nodes). A measured-zero from the source, not a fabrication. |
| **Code review** | 2 rounds · **1 CRITICAL** · FIX_REQUIRED→APPROVE · **1 fix cycle** | *(absent — `findings`/`verdicts`/`fix_cycles` all omitted)* | 🎯 **BLIND-LANE gap (the headline)**: the review was authored in the reviewer's untelemetered lane, the coder emitted 0 artifact events, and the review-PACKET false positive that would have leaked a bogus `APPROVE` was removed in Phase 1 (T002/F-08). So the honest rollup carries **no** review semantics and flags the three worker lanes `semantics_measured:false`. This is the diff the plan exists to make visible — not tuned away. |
| **Pre-build validation** | 1 run · VALIDATED | *(absent)* | 🎯 **BLIND-LANE gap**: ran in the validator's untelemetered lane. (Also: the validation extractor found no counts in the doc's shape — a secondary precision note.) |
| **Execution log** | 7 entries · 1 deviation | *captured (part of `artifact_events:6`), not a named fleet dimension* | ℹ️ **scope**: the rollup surfaces the packet-named dimensions (findings/verdicts/plan/workshop/flow); the execution-log, dossier (`findings:11`) and backpressure (`exists:10`) artifacts are captured (they count toward `artifact_events`) but are not aggregated as named fleet dimensions in this pass. The extractor's `deviations:7` (case-insensitive `Deviation` matches, incl. headers) vs §05's hand-counted 1 is a known precision gap (DL-005 class). |

## Honest headline

> **The fleet's quality signal — 1 CRITICAL intercepted, one FIX_REQUIRED→APPROVE fix cycle — is invisible to a telemetry-only rollup of the 051 run, because it happened in lanes that emitted no artifact telemetry.** The rollup reproduces the *planning* shape (plan, workshop, flight-plan) from the instrumented orchestrator lane, and says `semantics_measured:false` for the rest. Closing this needs the capture-side fixes the plan already lists: worker-lane artifact capture (F-07) and read-only-peer telemetry at teardown (F-05) — not a change to the rollup, which is honest as-is.

- Counts/ids/enums only (Constitution P12): pij ids, roles, harness labels, integer counts, the `CS-3` enum. No prose, no findings text, no verdict bodies — verified by the closed-schema test.
